name: Lookout's Spyglass
summary: The Lookout's Spyglass is a stolen instrument prized by the Thorium Brotherhood. Its loss leaves Searing Gorge's lookouts without an excellent tool for watching the area.

sections.title: A Stolen Instrument
sections.body: Dark Iron dwarves took the Lookout's Spyglass from the Thorium Brotherhood in Searing Gorge. The Brotherhood seeks its return to Taskmaster Scrange, who waits for the stolen goods.

faq.answer: The Lookout's Spyglass is an excellent monitoring tool used by lookouts.
The Thorium Brotherhood says Dark Iron dwarves in Searing Gorge stole the Lookout's Spyglass.
Taskmaster Scrange of the Thorium Brotherhood seeks the return of the stolen Lookout's Spyglass.

faq.q: Where are the Dark Iron Lookouts?
faq.answer: Dark Iron Lookouts watch from towers around the Slag Pit in Searing Gorge.

faq.q: Why does the Brotherhood want it?
faq.answer: The Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool for the lookouts.
